pairs.subject: the den of lions at dawn
pairs.question: Do the left and right images show the same place (the den of lions at dawn)?
pairs.left: Daniel standing calm and upright in the centre of the den, arms relaxed at his sides.; Several lions crouched or lying on the floor at varying distances from Daniel; Darius in court robes with a signet ring at the rim above, leaning forward; a faint luminous light suggesting the angel's presence without a visible human form.
pairs.right: Daniel, unharmed, being drawn up out of the pit by attendants; Lions below in the pit, calm and not attacking; a few palace attendants and guards at the rim; a faint dim torch on the wall
